purpose: Repair one evidence-path lookup in the registered hardware preflight without changing the frozen prompts, token arrays, model, runtime, scoring, request order, resource ceilings, or generation allocation.

observed_failure.interpretation: The failure is an implementation-path error before model launch, not a hardware failure or a scientific result.

root_cause.scope: Exactly one nested evidence lookup; the cumulative values themselves are unchanged.

repair_policy.implementation: A new wrapper must import the preserved original runner and may replace only the failing preflight call with a corrected versioned preflight.
repair_policy.generation_allocation: The original registered 96-request allocation is preserved; this amendment creates no additional generation budget.
repair_policy.run_policy: A run is permitted only after a separately authorized, stored PASS preflight_v2 whose live bindings equal a fresh corrected preflight. The original no-repeat guards remain effective.

unchanged_scientific_contract: All 96 registered token arrays and request hashes remain unchanged.
C0-C7 remain the only executable conditions; N_STYLE and N_HISTORY remain deactivated with zero attempts.
The model, weights, tokenizer, backend, chat template, quantization, context, generation settings, scorers, factorial weights, and missing-outcome policy remain unchanged.
The cumulative baseline remains 106 generations and 668.7530845000028 completion-inference seconds before this allocation.
The global ceilings remain 1200 generations and 72000 completion-inference seconds.
The evidence remains a disjoint held-out synthetic controlled-choice stimulus replication, not natural dialogue, real-speaker validation, cross-model validation, or confirmatory inference.
scientific_effect: NONE. This repair changes execution validity only and supplies no model observation, effect estimate, Persona Fidelity evidence, or algorithmic evidence.

Do not alter the original runner, original test, frozen manifest, original execution authorization, tokenizer records, prompts, or token arrays.
Do not rerun registration or tokenization.
Do not launch a model server or issue a completion before preflight_v2 is authorized and passes.
